headline: Renesas posts senior verification roles for automotive PMIC RNM/AMS environments
fact: Renesas posted related Senior Principal roles for Automotive PMIC verification, covering RNM/AMS model integration, RTL-to-GLS correlation, PVT analysis, switched-mode regulators/LDOs, cross-team handoffs and methodology leadership. The Chandler role also assigns evaluation of emerging verification technologies and AI-based solutions. A related Staff description requires PMIC RNM/AMS environment architecture and Verilog/SystemVerilog proficiency. These grouped requirements include exploratory AI evaluation, not proof of AI-generated models, deployed tools or measured benefits; the original August 19 Event date is retained.

sources.title: Senior Principal Verification Engineer — Chandler
sources.summary: Official Renesas requisition 20032032_2026-08-19 for Automotive PMIC verification leadership, RNM/AMS environment architecture, GLS correlation, PVT, ATE/Silicon Validation handoffs, mentoring, and methodology improvement.
